reason: The audit is free, but sending open PO, job and inventory exports from Epicor to an early-stage outside company needs my IT and legal people to sign off, and I can't get that done in 30 days. I've been burned by consultants who told us what we already knew, and this pitch sounds like that.
objection: Where does our supplier and job data go, who can see it, and what happens to it afterward? Even read-only and sanitized, I'm not sending it to a startup without an NDA and a clear data-use policy.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a plant I know that runs Epicor, plus a signed NDA and written data-handling terms, and a sample report from a comparable plant showing a real supplier delay my planners had missed.
